changes: The order editor tab is created once and reused for every order, always with active:false in the window the user is already in, so advancing the queue no longer opens or focuses a new tab.

Login problems are detected from the live page wording, which reports a rejected login as plain body text ('Incorrect username or password.') rather than an alert. Mail-code, passkey/identity-verification and rate-limit screens are reported separately.
A login that never produced a customer session can be retried on the same order by pressing the toolbar icon (RESUME_UNSUBMITTED), instead of being stuck until Success skips the order.

nodeTests.added: login-detection.test.mjs executes the shared browser script from LoginFormScripts.cs against the captions captured from the live Sign in page

nativeSelfTests: passed: identity/ACK/persistence/cancel, operator rotation and pair fixtures, plus resume now allowed after a submitted-but-unsuccessful login and still refused when an import intent is unsettled or the code is not retryable

liveLoginProbe.container: plain body text, no role=alert element
liveLoginProbe.surfaceCheck: LOGIN_FORM_READY, username/password/submit present, submit disabled until filled

review: Login detection verified against the live page wording with a fake account only; no customer credentials were used in development. The stored customer session is still the user's responsibility when Roblox asks for a challenge.
limitations: No automated proof of rendered gameplay; logs prove join, identity and identical server only
Live test covered two of the three operator accounts; the third is covered by fixtures
The rejected-password wording was captured today; if Roblox changes it again the new detector returns to a timeout instead of a wrong-password message
RAM v30 new accounts stay Default; existing alias/description/group preserved
